about: Dấu labels “Đề xuất” for underlining (D13) only on an app where in-place replacement measured wrong: Cursor. Every app types without underline until the user turns it on. Brave, Arc, Zalo, Discord, Slack, Notion, Obsidian and Figma were labeled by technology class without measurement and lost the label; Chrome, Edge, Firefox and VS Code lost it on 10/11/2026 after in-place replacement measured right. Terminal is not suggested. Bundle IDs from docs/Compatibility.md section 3.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.note: Electron. Measured 10/11/2026: in-place right at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal after the M6 late-answer fix (14 of 15 runs right; the wrong run was not a replacement-position error); label removed.

apps.name: Google Chrome
apps.note: Chromium. Measured 10/11/2026: in-place right at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal after the M6 late-answer fix; label removed.

apps.name: Microsoft Edge
apps.note: Chromium (Microsoft Edge Framework). Measured 10/11/2026: in-place right in 9 of 9 runs at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal and 3 of 3 with a busy page, after the M6 late-answer fix; label removed.

apps.name: Cursor
apps.note: Electron (built from VS Code 1.128). Measured 10/11/2026 (3.29.15, docs/Compatibility.md 5.4): the agents prompt is right at 5, 20 and 100 ms. In the editor in-place is right at 20 ms with the standard string and at 100 ms, wrong at 5 ms and in the "anh ddi" case at 20 ms; underline is right at 5 ms. The editor counts positions from the start of the word.

apps.name: Figma
apps.note: Electron, content drawn on a canvas. Not measured.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.note: Gecko. Measured 10/11/2026: in-place right at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal after the M6 late-answer fix; label removed.
